requirements.Title: NGB Keyed Ink Bottles with Increased Yield
requirements.Description: Develop new NGB keyed ink bottles with 6K Black and 6K CMY page yield, and ensure CMY bottle sizes support >8K page yield.
requirements.Rationale: Higher yield bottles reduce frequency of replacement and lower total cost of ownership, supporting high-volume users and competitive positioning.
requirements.Dependencies: Bottle design, IDS system compatibility, ink formulation reuse
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NGB bottles are available in 6K Black and 6K CMY, CMY bottle is available in a size supporting >8K yield; bottles are keyed for correct installation.

requirements.Title: Spill-Free Ink Bottle Reliability
requirements.Description: Ensure that the ink bottle and tank interface is spill-free during user installation and refilling.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces mess, improves user satisfaction, and lowers support costs from spill-related incidents.
requirements.Dependencies: Bottle and tank interface design, NOA-F integration
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: User testing confirms no ink spillage in >99% of installations/refills under normal conditions.

requirements.Title: NOA-F with Metal Foiled Labyrinth and Lid Label
requirements.Description: Integrate NOA-F (Next-Gen Output Assembly - Filter) with a metal-foiled labyrinth and a lid label into the product.
requirements.Rationale: Improves reliability, ink flow management, and product differentiation.
requirements.Dependencies: NOA-F component supply, manufacturing process update
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F is present with specified labyrinth and lid label in all units; passes reliability and ink flow tests.

requirements.Title: Reuse SuperAmp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie Ink
requirements.Description: Reuse the SuperAmp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie pigment inks without ink reformulation for the Magellan platform.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces development time and leverages existing validated technology.
requirements.Dependencies: Compatibility verification with new system architecture
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SuperAmp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie inks are used in the new product without reformulation; system passes all functional and reliability tests.

requirements.Title: Enhanced Reliability, WVTR, Air Gain, Flow Rate, and IDS Characterization
requirements.Description: Model and characterize reliability, Water Vapor Transmission Rate (WVTR), air gain, flow rate, and IDS (Ink Delivery System) for startup and NOA-F end-of-life (EOL).
requirements.Rationale: Ensures long-term performance and reliability of the ink delivery system.
requirements.Dependencies: Access to test data, modeling resources
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Complete documented models and test data for all specified parameters, reviewed and approved by QA.

requirements.Title: Ink Stability Modeling (Tank and PQ Impact)
requirements.Description: Develop predictive models for ink stability in the tank and its impact on print quality (PQ).
requirements.Rationale: Prevents print quality issues and supports warranty commitments.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Model accurately predicts ink stability and PQ outcomes over expected usage period.

requirements.Title: Support for Service Parts and Warranty for NOA-F
requirements.Description: NOA-F must be available as a service part and supported under warranty.
requirements.Rationale: Enables field serviceability and supports warranty claims.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F is available as a service part and covered under warranty per policy.

requirements.Title: Acumen 6 on Lid
requirements.Description: Integrate Acumen 6 technology on the ink bottle or tank lid.
requirements.Rationale: Provides enhanced authentication or tracking for consumables.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Acumen 6 is present and functional on all lids; passes security and usability tests.

requirements.Title: Factory Line Modifications for NOA-F and Magi Ink Cart
requirements.Description: Modify existing SA14 production line for NOA-F and add Magi ink cartridge and labeling tool in Orcus 5 line.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures manufacturing capability for new components and labeling requirements.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Production lines are modified, validated, and ready for volume manufacturing before launch.

requirements.Title: Support Customer Replaceable PHA and NOA-F
requirements.Description: Design the product so that PHA (Printhead Assembly) and NOA-F are customer-replaceable parts.
requirements.Rationale: Improves serviceability, reduces downtime, and lowers service costs.
requirements.Stakeholders: End Users, Service Teams, Product Management
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: End users can replace PHA and NOA-F with basic instructions; validated by usability testing.

requirements.Title: Warranty Page Life Goal of 80K Pages
requirements.Description: Product must support a new warranty page life goal of 80,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: Improves value proposition and supports high-volume use cases.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product reliably achieves 80,000 pages under normal use conditions; validated by endurance testing.

requirements.Title: SKU 2 (Hi + Hi PDL) PaaS
requirements.Description: Launch SKU 2 with high capacity and high PDL (Page Description Language) support as part of Printer as a Service (PaaS) offering.
requirements.Rationale: Expands product offering to different customer segments and supports service-based business models.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SKU 2 is available for order with PaaS, and supports high PDL as specified.

requirements.Title: Reddington ID with Increased Tank Size
requirements.Description: Adopt Reddington industrial design (ID) with increased tank size; no change to Marconi-HI ADF.
requirements.Rationale: Supports higher ink capacity and aligns with new bottle sizes.
requirements.Dependencies: Tank and chassis redesign, ID approval
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product design is approved with increased tank size and Reddington ID; passes mechanical fit and finish tests.

requirements.Title: EPS Foam Packaging
requirements.Description: Use EPS foam for product packaging.
requirements.Rationale: Protects product during shipment and handling.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product passes all standard packaging drop and vibration tests with EPS foam packaging.

requirements.Title: EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel Certification for PDL SKU
requirements.Description: Ensure EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel environmental certifications for the PDL SKU.
requirements.Rationale: Meets regulatory and sustainability requirements for target markets.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PDL SKU is listed as certified for EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel before launch.

requirements.Title: Input/Output Tray Modifications for Tank Protrusion
requirements.Description: Modify input and output trays to accommodate tank protrusion and optimize product size.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures mechanical compatibility and optimizes overall footprint.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Trays are compatible with tank protrusion and pass all functional and durability tests.

requirements.Title: 4.3” CGD Display
requirements.Description: Integrate a 4.3-inch CGD (Color Graphic Display) into the control panel.
requirements.Rationale: Enhances usability and supports advanced UI features.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All units include a 4.3” CGD, and UI is fully functional and validated.

requirements.Title: Four-Tube Platform Using Sayan Sibstar Tubes
requirements.Description: Leverage Sayan Sibstar tubes with new routing and integration for a four-tube ink delivery platform.
requirements.Rationale: Supports increased ink flow and reliability for new tank and bottle sizes.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: System uses four Sayan Sibstar tubes with validated routing and integration.

requirements.Title: Service Station Aerosol Management
requirements.Description: Update service station for improved aerosol management, considering spit platform changes due to new tank.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces ink aerosol contamination and improves reliability.
requirements.Dependencies: Service station redesign, aerosol test results
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Service station passes aerosol management tests with new tank configuration.

requirements.Title: Carriage Dynamic and Force Model Update
requirements.Description: Update carriage dynamic and force models to account for new tube routing and increased weights.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures print quality and mechanical reliability with new hardware configuration.
requirements.Dependencies: Tube and tank design, mechanical modeling
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Validated dynamic and force models for carriage with new configuration.

requirements.Title: Paper Path Support for Increased Page Life
requirements.Description: Redesign paper path to support increased page life (80K pages).
requirements.Rationale: Ensures reliable paper handling over product lifetime.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Paper path supports 80K page life without increased jam or wear rates.

requirements.Title: Serviceable Ink Maintenance Part (Post-80K Life)
requirements.Description: Designate an ink maintenance part as serviceable by service centers after 80K page life is reached.
requirements.Rationale: Supports extended product use and post-warranty servicing.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Ink maintenance part is replaceable by service centers and documented in service manuals.

requirements.Title: New Make-Break and FI Connection for IDS
requirements.Description: Implement a new make-break and fluidic interconnect (FI) connection in the Ink Delivery System (IDS), leveraging LEBI ink-tank with increased size, keying, and LOI One SHAID.
requirements.Rationale: Supports new bottle and tank architecture and enhances reliability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: IDS with new make-break and FI connection is fully integrated and validated for reliability.

requirements.Title: New IDS Startup Algorithm and Air Management
requirements.Description: Develop a new startup algorithm for the IDS, including improved air management.
requirements.Rationale: Improves startup reliability and reduces air-related print defects.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Startup process is robust, with air management validated by test prints and startup cycles.

requirements.Title: New Print Quality Goals and Depletion Definition
requirements.Description: Define new print quality (PQ) goals and ink depletion criteria to align with updated page yield definitions.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures consistent quality and meets customer expectations for yield.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Documented PQ goals and depletion definitions are met in product validation tests.

requirements.Title: Reuse Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, Raccoon PSU
requirements.Description: Reuse Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, and Raccoon PSU in the new platform.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces development cost and leverages proven hardware.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All reused components are fully compatible and pass functional validation.

requirements.Title: Stingray Wi-Fi Module Integration
requirements.Description: Integrate the Stingray Wi-Fi module for wireless connectivity.
requirements.Rationale: Provides robust wireless printing capabilities.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Stingray Wi-Fi module is present in all units and passes wireless connectivity tests.

requirements.Title: Dune Firmware Platform
requirements.Description: Adopt Dune as the firmware platform for the Magellan printer.
requirements.Rationale: Provides a consistent and up-to-date firmware environment.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All units run Dune firmware; passes all required functional and security tests.

requirements.Title: Gauss4.xx Security Platform (HW & FW)
requirements.Description: Integrate Gauss4.xx security platform for both hardware and firmware.
requirements.Rationale: Strengthens device and data security, meeting enterprise requirements.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Device passes all Gauss4.xx security validation tests and certifications.

requirements.Title: High Print Speed: 25/20 ppm (PDL: 25/19 ppm)
requirements.Description: Achieve print speeds of 25/20 pages per minute (ppm), and 25/19 ppm for PDL.
requirements.Rationale: Supports productivity needs for SMB and enterprise markets.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product achieves specified print speeds in standard test conditions.

requirements.Title: SMB and Enterprise Solution Integration
requirements.Description: Integrate scan solution, SMB manageability, and enterprise support (WJA, HPSM, JAM) into the product.
requirements.Rationale: Expands market reach and supports business workflows.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product supports all listed solutions and passes integration testing.

requirements.Title: Client and Driver Support: HPX, PSA, SUPD, UPD, EasyStart, USS, UFD
requirements.Description: Support a comprehensive set of clients and drivers: HPX, PSA, SUPD, UPD, EasyStart, USS, and UFD.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures broad compatibility and ease of deployment for various customer segments.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All listed drivers are available and validated for the product.

requirements.Title: SuperAmp PHA Life at 65K Pages (Constraint)
requirements.Description: SuperAmp PHA must achieve a life of 65,000 pages as a hard constraint.
requirements.Rationale: Critical for reliability and warranty compliance.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SuperAmp PHA achieves 65K page life in accelerated life tests.

requirements.Title: Warranty Life: 2 Years or Page Limit
requirements.Description: Provide a warranty for 2 years or the specified page limit, whichever comes first.
requirements.Rationale: Aligns with market expectations and supports sales.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Warranty terms are clearly stated and supported by product reliability data.

requirements.Title: Serviceability: Maintenance Box
requirements.Description: Design for easy serviceability, including a replaceable maintenance box.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces service time and cost, improves user experience.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance box is easily replaceable and documented in user/service manuals.

requirements.Title: Host 12K-CMYK (Flexible)
requirements.Description: Optionally support 12K page yield for CMYK as a flexible goal.
requirements.Rationale: Provides future scalability for high-volume use cases.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: 12K-CMYK variant is available as an option and validated for yield.

requirements.Title: Trade Page 6K (Flexible)
requirements.Description: Optionally offer a trade SKU with 6K page yield as a flexible goal.
requirements.Rationale: Enables market-specific or promotional offerings.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: 6K trade SKU is available and validated for yield.
